description: Test functions for the store layer handling blocks in the focalboard project, including CRUD operations, history, and subtree retrieval.

methods.name: StoreTestBlocksStore
methods.description: Runs a suite of subtests for block store operations, including insert, patch, delete, get, duplicate, and history retrieval.

methods.name: testInsertBlock
methods.description: Tests inserting blocks with valid and invalid data, including size limits and updates.

methods.name: testInsertBlocks
methods.description: Tests batch insertion of blocks, handling invalid blocks.

methods.name: testPatchBlock
methods.description: Tests updating blocks, including field updates, deletions, and error cases.

methods.name: testPatchBlocks
methods.description: Tests batch patching of blocks, including error handling.

methods.name: testGetSubTree2
methods.description: Tests retrieval of subtree blocks from a parent ID, including non-existent IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteBlock
methods.description: Tests deleting blocks by ID, including multiple deletions and non-existent IDs.

methods.name: testUndeleteBlock
methods.description: Tests undeleting blocks, verifying restoration and error handling.

methods.name: testGetBlocks
methods.description: Tests retrieval of blocks by various filters, including parent, type, IDs, and full list.

methods.name: testGetBlock
methods.description: Tests fetching individual blocks and handling non-existent IDs.

methods.name: testDuplicateBlock
methods.description: Tests duplicating blocks as templates or normal, handling non-existent references.

methods.name: testGetBlockMetadata
methods.description: Tests retrieval of block metadata and history, including ordering and filtering.

methods.name: testUndeleteBlockChildren
methods.description: Tests restoring deleted blocks and boards, verifying hierarchical restoration.

methods.name: testGetBlockHistoryNewestChildren
methods.description: Tests fetching latest child blocks with pagination, including patch and delete operations.
